claim_text: A model can repeat a shared block to increase latent computation depth at test time without emitting additional reasoning tokens.
caveat: Applies to the architecture studied by Geiping et al.; not every model.

claim_text: Additional recurrent updates can change a state and prediction.
caveat: Committed depth-sensitive fixture and tests demonstrate the bounded toy claim.

claim_text: More recurrent updates are not guaranteed to help indefinitely.
caveat: Committed disconnected fixture reaches a fixed point; this demonstrates saturation only.

claim_text: Coconut feeds the last hidden state back as a continuous input representation rather than decoding an intermediate word token.
caveat: Coconut is not architecturally identical to recurrent-depth models.

claim_text: BDH is described as a graph-based attention/state-space architecture of locally interacting neuron particles.
caveat: Do not infer biological equivalence or full public reproducibility.

claim_text: BDH inference working memory is described by its authors through evolving edge state associated with Hebbian-style reweighting.
caveat: Author description in §1.2–1.3 and §2; not reproduced here.

claim_text: BDH-CQ processes demonstrations into recurrent contextual memory and then iterates a separate latent query workspace before decoding.
caveat: Supported by §3.2–3.3; exact update rules and dimensions remain proprietary.

claim_text: BDH-CQ's paper reports 29.5% pass@2 for a 150M configuration at a computed $0.00070 per ARC-AGI-1 task.
caveat: Reported in §5; not reproduced here and intentionally omitted from the teaching flow.

claim_text: The toy substrate executes fixed-size recurrent grid-state updates and compares them with an independent BFS oracle.
caveat: Engine and oracle are separate modules with passing tests.

claim_text: The toy substrate is BDH or BDH-CQ.
caveat: Explicitly false framing; persistent non-equivalence statement required.

claim_text: BDH-CQ contextual memory and query workspace have different conceptual roles.
caveat: §3.3; system-level interface only, with implementation details proprietary.

claim_text: No unrelated third-party reproduction of BDH or BDH-CQ was identified in this project's review.
caveat: Absence claim is limited to this review; BDH-CQ reports a black-box audit involving paper co-authors.

claim_text: Recurrent-depth models and Coconut are distinct mechanisms for additional latent computation.
caveat: Mechanism-level comparison only; neither is treated as BDH-CQ-equivalent.
